newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle up in light volume, dull trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle up in light volume, dull trade.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled firmer after speculative buying pierced stops and lifted most-active May to the high of 84.50 cents, traders said.
Prices remained in a range between resistance, pegged at Thursday's high of 85.15 cents and support, seen at the recent low of 79.40 cents basis the May contract.
Technicals continue to dominate the market, industry sources said.

On the fundamental side, "the only good news is that bad news is out," an analyst said. "The big picture is world supply. World supply is still more than ample and that is what will keep pressure on the market."

The U.S. Department of Agriculture will issue Florida crop estimates through July. Analysts said an upward revision of the current forecast of a record 222 million 90-lb boxes, would not be surprising.
May juice ended up 1.00 cent at 83.65 cents per pound, having ranged from 84.50 to 82.90 cents. The back months settled 0.70 to 1.85 higher.
Volume was estimated at 1,700 lots compared with Friday's official 1,442 lots.
